from itertools import groupby
timeSeriesP = re.compile(r'(\w+)_(\d+)$')
timeSeriesIndeces = dict(
                        (key,[int(tpl[1]) for tpl in group]) for key, group in groupby(
                                [timeSeriesP.match(n).groups() for n in fiData.columns if timeSeriesP.match(n)],
                            lambda tpl:tpl[0])
                        )
nonTimeSeriesNames = [n for n in fiData.columns if not timeSeriesP.match(n)]
timeSeriesNames = np.unique([timeSeriesP.match(n).group(1) for n in fiData.columns if timeSeriesP.match(n)])
FInames=[name for name in timeSeriesNames if name not in {'collected_by_anon', 'collection_date', 'date_due', 'temperature', 'body_weight'}]
groups = [{'diet':d, 'strain':s, 'sex':g} for s,d,g in np.unique(fiData.loc[:, ['strain','diet','sex']].values.astype('str'), axis=0)]
groupInds = [fiData.index[np.all([(fiData[key]==value).values for key, value in groupDict.items()],axis=0)] for groupDict in groups]

def getCollectionDays(row):
    if str(row.iloc[1]) == 'nan':
        return np.nan
    else:
        return date.fromisoformat(str(row.iloc[1]))-date.fromisoformat(str(row.iloc[0]))

name = 'collection_date'
timegrids = pd.concat([fiData.loc[:, ['date_born', name+'_'+str(i)]].apply(getCollectionDays, axis=1) for i in timeSeriesIndeces[name]],
          axis=1, 
          keys=[name+'_'+str(i) for i in timeSeriesIndeces[name]]
         )
name = 'collected_by_anon'
raIDs = pd.concat([fiData.loc[:, name+'_'+str(i)] for i in timeSeriesIndeces[name]],
          axis=1, 
          keys=[name+'_'+str(i) for i in timeSeriesIndeces[name]]
         )
TxWs = pd.concat([pd.concat([fiData.loc[:, name+'_'+str(i)] for i in timeSeriesIndeces[name]],
                            axis=1, 
                            keys=[(i,name) for i in timeSeriesIndeces[name]]
                          ) for name in ['temperature', 'body_weight'] 
              ], axis=1).sort_index(axis=1)

def countDeficit(series):
    if len(series.dropna())==0:
        return np.nan
    else:
        return float(np.sum([score==1.0 for score in series.dropna()]))
deficits = pd.concat([FIs.loc[:, i].apply(countDeficit, axis=1) for i in np.unique(FIs.columns.get_level_values(0))],
                      axis=1,
                      keys=np.unique(FIs.columns.get_level_values(0))
                    )

fig, axes = plt.subplots(nrows=len(groupInds), ncols=4)
for j, miceInds in enumerate(groupInds):
    weekInds = observationsStacked.loc[miceInds, :].reorder_levels(['weeks','mice id']).groupby('weeks').agg('size')>=5
    cleanScores = observationsStacked.reset_index().set_index('mice id').loc[miceInds,:].reset_index().set_index('weeks').loc[weekInds, 'FI score']
    for i, (name, func_est, func_SE) in enumerate([('Mean', 'mean', lambda x:x.mean()/np.sqrt(x.size)),
                                                   ('S.D.','std', lambda x:np.sqrt((moment(x,moment=4)-np.power(np.std(x),4)*(x.size-3)/(x.size-1))
                                                                                  /x.size)/2/np.std(x)),
                                                   ('C.V.',lambda x:x.std()/x.mean(), lambda x:x.std()/x.mean()/np.sqrt(2*x.size)),
                                                   ('Skewness','skew', lambda x:np.sqrt(6*x.size*(x.size-1)/(x.size-2)/(x.size+1)/(x.size+3)) )
                                                  ]):
        data = cleanScores.groupby('weeks').agg(func_est)
        dataSE = cleanScores.groupby('weeks').agg(func_SE)
        z, c = np.polyfit(data.index, data.values, 2, w=1/dataSE.values, cov=True)
        p = np.poly1d(z)

        axes[j][i].errorbar(x=data.index, y=data.values,
                            yerr=dataSE.values,
                            fmt='ro', ecolor='r', elinewidth=.75, ms=3
                           )
        axes[j][i].plot(data.index, p(data.index), 'k--')
        axes[j][i].set_ylabel(name)
        axes[j][i].set_xlabel('Age (weeks)')
        seaborn.despine()
    axes[j][1].set_title(str(groups[j]))
fig.set_size_inches(12, 3*len(groupInds))
plt.tight_layout()
fig.savefig('mice frailty statistics.png', dpi=600)

fig.savefig('mice frailty statistics.pdf')

groupStates = {}
for j, miceInds in enumerate(groupInds):
    weekInds = deficitsStacked.loc[miceInds, :].reorder_levels(['weeks','mice id']).groupby('weeks').agg('size')>=5
    obsNs = []
    for miceI in miceInds:
        trace = deficitsStacked.reset_index().set_index('mice id').loc[miceI, ['age','# deficits']]
        if type(trace) == pd.Series:
            obsNs.append((miceI, 1))
            continue
        obsNs.append((miceI, len(trace)))
           
    groupStates[j] = np.zeros((len(obsNs),np.max([r[1] for r in obsNs])))-1
    for i, (miceI, l) in enumerate(sorted(obsNs, key=lambda r:r[1])):
        trace = deficitsStacked.reset_index().set_index('mice id').loc[miceI, ['age','# deficits']]
        if l>1:
            groupStates[j][i,:l]=trace['# deficits'].values
        if l==1:
            groupStates[j][i,0]=trace['# deficits']

def deficit2colormap(dfct, threshold=5.5):
    if dfct == -1:
        return -1
    else:
        return np.power(dfct,6)/(np.power(dfct,6)+np.power(threshold,6))

miceHistories = {}
recoverySurvs = {}
for threshold in [3.5, 4.5, 5.5]:
    recoverySurvs[threshold] = []
    miceHistories[threshold] = {}
    for j, miceInds in enumerate(groupInds):
        weekInds = deficitsStacked.loc[miceInds, :].reorder_levels(['weeks','mice id']).groupby('weeks').agg('size')>=5
        for miceI in miceInds:
            trace = deficitsStacked.reset_index().set_index('mice id').loc[miceI, ['age','# deficits']]
            if type(trace) == pd.Series:
                miceHistories[threshold][miceI] = None
                continue
        
            cured = np.array(trace['# deficits'].iloc[:-1]>threshold) & np.array(trace['# deficits'].iloc[1:]<threshold)
            cured = trace['age'].iloc[1:].loc[cured].values/pd.Timedelta('7 Day')
            sick = np.array(trace['# deficits'].iloc[:-1]<threshold) & np.array(trace['# deficits'].iloc[1:]>threshold)
            sick = trace['age'].iloc[1:].loc[sick].values/pd.Timedelta('7 Day')
            tIndex = trace['age'].values/pd.Timedelta('7 Day')
            miceHistories[threshold][miceI] = sorted([(tIndex[0], 'start')]+
                                       [(v,'recovered') for v in cured]+
                                       [(v,'sick') for v in sick]+
                                       [(tIndex[-1], 'end')],key=lambda r:r[0]
                                      )

            hist = miceHistories[threshold][miceI]
            if hist is None:
                continue
            for i in range(len(hist)-1):
                if hist[i][1] == 'sick' and  hist[i+1][1] == 'recovered':
                    recoverySurvs[threshold].append((hist[i+1][0]-hist[i][0], True, miceI, j))
                elif hist[i][1] == 'sick' and  hist[i+1][1] == 'end':
                    recoverySurvs[threshold].append((hist[i+1][0]-hist[i][0], False, miceI, j))
                elif hist[i][1] == 'start' and  hist[i+1][1] == 'recovered':
                    recoverySurvs[threshold].append((hist[i+1][0]-hist[i][0], True, miceI, j))
                
    recoverySurvs[threshold] = pd.DataFrame(data=recoverySurvs[threshold], columns=['time','event','mice ID','group ID'])

from lifelines import KaplanMeierFitter

rng = np.random.default_rng(12345)

def bootstrapMeanStd(statFunc, sample, Nsamples = 200):
    
    if len(sample) < 10:
        return np.nan
    else:
        resampleStats = []
        for i in range(Nsamples):
            resampleStats.append(statFunc(np.array([sample[j] for j in rng.integers(low=0,high=len(sample),size=len(sample))])))
        return (np.mean(resampleStats,axis=0),np.std(resampleStats,axis=0))
    
def cohortDataLongevitySteepness(data):
    
    kmf = KaplanMeierFitter()
    kmf.fit(data[:, 0], data[:, 1])
    qs = np.interp([0.75,0.5,0.25], np.flip(np.array(kmf.survival_function_).transpose())[0], np.flip(kmf.timeline))
    return (qs[1], qs[1]/(qs[2]-qs[0]))

def cohortDataLongevityICV(data):
    
    kmf = KaplanMeierFitter()
    kmf.fit(data[:, 0], data[:, 1])
    mean = np.dot(kmf.survival_function_.index[1:]-kmf.survival_function_.index[:-1],kmf.survival_function_.values[:-1])
    tsquared = 2*np.dot(
        np.array(
            (kmf.survival_function_.index[1:]+kmf.survival_function_.index[:-1])/2
        ) * kmf.survival_function_.values[:-1].transpose()[0],
        np.array(kmf.survival_function_.index[1:]-kmf.survival_function_.index[:-1])
        )
    return (mean, mean/np.sqrt(tsquared - mean*mean))

def cohortDataLongevityICVtrimmed(data, frac=0.9):

    trimmed = np.sort(data,axis=0)[-int(len(data)*frac):]

    kmf = KaplanMeierFitter()
    kmf.fit(trimmed[:, 0], trimmed[:, 1])
    mean = np.dot(kmf.survival_function_.index[1:]-kmf.survival_function_.index[:-1],kmf.survival_function_.values[:-1])
    tsquared = 2*np.dot(
        np.array(
            (kmf.survival_function_.index[1:]+kmf.survival_function_.index[:-1])/2
        ) * kmf.survival_function_.values[:-1].transpose()[0],
        np.array(kmf.survival_function_.index[1:]-kmf.survival_function_.index[:-1])
        )
    return (mean[0], (mean/np.sqrt(tsquared - mean*mean))[0])

relCohortDataSets = []
msrs = ['lifespan', 'steepness', 'absolute sickspan', 'relative sickspan']
for sickspans in [sickspans4, sickspans5, sickspans6]:
    cohortData = []
    for j, miceInds in enumerate(groupInds): 
        cohortLongevitySteepnessMeanErr=bootstrapMeanStd(cohortDataLongevityICVtrimmed, miceSurvData.loc[miceInds, :].values)
        cohortRSickpanMeanErr=(lambda x:(np.mean(x),np.std(x)/np.sqrt(x.size)))(
            sickspans.loc[miceInds].values.transpose()/
            miceSurvData.loc[miceInds, 'Lifespan (weeks)'].values
            )
        cohortASickpanMeanErr=(lambda x:(np.mean(x),np.std(x)/np.sqrt(x.size)))(
            sickspans.loc[miceInds].values.transpose()
            )
        cohortData.append((groups[j]['strain'], groups[j]['sex'], groups[j]['diet'],
            cohortLongevitySteepnessMeanErr[0][0],
            cohortLongevitySteepnessMeanErr[1][0],
            cohortLongevitySteepnessMeanErr[0][1],
            cohortLongevitySteepnessMeanErr[1][1],
            cohortASickpanMeanErr[0],
            cohortASickpanMeanErr[1],               
            cohortRSickpanMeanErr[0],
            cohortRSickpanMeanErr[1]
            ))
    cohortData=pd.DataFrame(data=cohortData, columns=['strain', 'sex', 'diet', 
                                                      'lifespan', 'lifespan S.E.',
                                                      'steepness', 'steepness S.E.',
                                                      'absolute sickspan', 'absolute sickspan S.E.',
                                                      'relative sickspan', 'relative sickspan S.E.'
                                                 ])
    
    for msr in msrs:
        cohortData[msr+' C.V.'] = cohortData[msr+' S.E.']/cohortData[msr]

    relCohortData = pd.concat(
          [cohortData.loc[list(range(2))+list(range(3,7)), ['strain', 'sex', 'diet']],
           cohortData.loc[list(range(2))+list(range(3,7)), msrs]/cohortData.loc[2, msrs],
               (
                np.power(cohortData.loc[list(range(2))+list(range(3,7)), [msr+' C.V.' for msr in msrs]],2)+
                np.power(cohortData.loc[2, [msr+' C.V.' for msr in msrs]],2)
               ).map(lambda x:np.sqrt(float(x)))
          ],axis=1)
    
    relCohortDataSets.append(relCohortData)

for j in range(3):
    relCohortData = relCohortDataSets[j]
    plt.figure()
    
    plt.errorbar(relCohortData['steepness'],
             relCohortData['relative sickspan'],
             xerr=relCohortData['steepness']*relCohortData['steepness C.V.'],
             yerr=relCohortData['relative sickspan']*relCohortData['relative sickspan C.V.'],
             fmt='o',mec='none', ms=3,
             elinewidth=.8,
             capthick=0.5,
             capsize=3,
             ecolor=seaborn.color_palette()[1],
             color=seaborn.color_palette()[1]
            )
    plt.xscale('log')
    plt.yscale('log')

    labels = ["{0}\n{1} {2}".format(
         relCohortData['strain'][i],
         relCohortData['sex'][i],
         relCohortData['diet'][i]
        ) for i in relCohortData.index
    ]
    for i in range(3,7):
        labels[i-1] = relCohortData.loc[i,'diet']

    offsets = [(3,2)]*7
    alighments = [('left','bottom')]*7
    offsets[1] = [-3,-2]
    alighments[1] = ('right','top')

    X = sm.add_constant(np.log([float(f) for f in relCohortData['steepness']]))
    ols_model = sm.OLS(np.log([float(f) for f in relCohortData['relative sickspan']]), X)
    est = ols_model.fit()

    Xrange = np.arange(np.log(0.4), np.log(1.8) ,0.01)
    y_pred = est.predict([(1,x) for x in Xrange])
    x_pred = np.log([float(f) for f in relCohortData['steepness']])
    pred = est.get_prediction([(1,x) for x in Xrange]).summary_frame(alpha=0.05)

    plt.fill_between(np.exp(Xrange), np.exp(pred['mean_ci_upper']), np.exp(pred['mean_ci_lower']), alpha=0.3,label='linear regression')
    plt.plot(np.exp(Xrange), np.exp(y_pred), '-', color=seaborn.color_palette()[0],linewidth=1.)

    plt.ylim([0.2, 5])
    seaborn.despine()
    plt.xticks([0.4, 0.6, 1, 1.5])
    plt.yticks([0.3, 0.6, 1, 2])
    plt.gca().set_xticklabels(['.4', '.6', '1', '1.5']);
    plt.gca().set_yticklabels(['.3', '.6', '1', '2']);

    plt.gcf().set_size_inches(2, 1.5)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.gcf().savefig('mice FI sickspan'+str(j+4)+'-ICV.png',dpi=600,bbox_inches='tight')
    plt.gcf().savefig('mice FI sickspan'+str(j+4)+'-ICV.pdf',bbox_inches='tight')

             elinewidth=.8,
             capthick=0.5,
             capsize=3,
             ecolor=seaborn.color_palette()[1],
             color=seaborn.color_palette()[1]
            )
    plt.xscale('log')
    plt.yscale('log')

    X = sm.add_constant(np.log([float(f) for f in relCohortData['lifespan']]))
    ols_model = sm.OLS(np.log([float(f) for f in relCohortData['relative sickspan']]), X)
    est = ols_model.fit()

    Xrange = np.arange(np.log(0.8), np.log(1.3) ,0.01)
    y_pred = est.predict([(1,x) for x in Xrange])
    x_pred = np.log([float(f) for f in relCohortData['steepness']])
    pred = est.get_prediction([(1,x) for x in Xrange]).summary_frame(alpha=0.05)
    
    plt.fill_between(np.exp(Xrange), np.exp(pred['mean_ci_upper']), np.exp(pred['mean_ci_lower']), alpha=0.3,label='linear regression')
    plt.plot(np.exp(Xrange), np.exp(y_pred), '-', color=seaborn.color_palette()[0],linewidth=1.)

    plt.ylim([0.2, 3])
    plt.xlim([0.8, 1.3])
    seaborn.despine()
    plt.xticks([0.8, 0.9, 1., 1.1, 1.3])
    plt.yticks([0.3, 0.6, 1, 2])
    plt.gca().set_xticklabels(['.8', '.9', '1.', '1.1', '1.3']);
    plt.gca().set_yticklabels(['.3', '.6', '1', '2']);

    plt.gcf().set_size_inches(2, 1.5)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.gcf().savefig('mice FI sickspan'+str(i+4)+'-longevity.png',dpi=600,bbox_inches='tight')
    plt.gcf().savefig('mice FI sickspan'+str(i+4)+'-longevity.pdf',bbox_inches='tight')
